import os, json, urllib.request
email = 'a.nikolaev@sheffield.ac.uk'
doi = '10.1523/JNEUROSCI.0808-13.2013'

# Unpaywall
try:
    url = f'https://api.unpaywall.org/v2/{doi}?email={email}'
    req = urllib.request.Request(url, headers={'User-Agent': f'paper-downloader/1.0 (mailto:{email})'})
    with urllib.request.urlopen(req, timeout=30) as resp:
        data = json.loads(resp.read().decode())
    print('UNPAYWALL is_oa:', data.get('is_oa'))
    print('UNPAYWALL best_oa:', data.get('best_oa_location'))
    for loc in data.get('oa_locations', []):
        print(' OA loc:', loc.get('url_for_pdf'), '|', loc.get('version'), '|', loc.get('host_type'))
except Exception as e:
    print('UNPAYWALL ERR:', e)

# PubMed/PMC ID conversion for this DOI
try:
    url = f'https://www.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/pmc/utils/idconv/v1.0/?ids={doi}&format=json&tool=arf&email={email}'
    req = urllib.request.Request(url, headers={'User-Agent': f'paper-downloader/1.0 (mailto:{email})'})
    with urllib.request.urlopen(req, timeout=30) as resp:
        data = json.loads(resp.read().decode())
    print('PMC IDCONV:', data)
except Exception as e:
    print('PMC IDCONV ERR:', e)
